answer: Because the vault fee is applied at the tide exit, the haven audit totals the burn and the ledger shows exactly what left. An operator rotating funds across many keys thus bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never pays. Withdrawing stake burns a 7% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. Each copy needs 2 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
